newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: BARCELONA DECLINE INVITATION TO KOEMAN'S FAREWELL.
newsitem.headline: BARCELONA DECLINE INVITATION TO KOEMAN'S FAREWELL.

text.p: Barcelona have declined an invitation to play a friendly in Rotterdam to mark the retirement of Feyenoord's former Dutch international defender Ronald Koeman, news agency ANP said on Monday.

Koeman had hoped his former club Barcelona would make the trip to the Netherlands for the match on August 9 but the Catalan side said the game did not fit in with their plans ahead of possible European matches early next season.

The 34-year-old Koeman is retiring at the end of this season after a glittering career highlighted by European Cup wins with PSV Eindhoven in 1988 and Barcelona in 1992 and the European championship with the Netherlands in 1988.
Feyenoord are searching for another suitable foreign opponent to mark Koeman's departure, ANP said.
